meta.title: Financing a Solar System – Subsidies, Costs & Payback in Switzerland
meta.description: Plan your photovoltaic system with an investment range, the Pronovo one-off subsidy (EIV), cantonal programmes, tax aspects and a conservative profitability calculation.

intro.title: An investment that works for you.
intro.lead: A photovoltaic system costs once and then produces for decades – here are the figures we can back up.

funding.title: Subsidies lower the investment.
funding.lead: The federal government, the cantons and some municipalities support photovoltaics. Because the programmes change constantly, we check them for your location on the day.

items.title: Pronovo EIV
items.text: The federal one-off subsidy (EIV) noticeably lowers the investment. We calculate it for your project at current rates and handle the application for you.

items.title: Cantonal & municipal programmes
items.text: Some cantons, municipalities and energy utilities offer additional support – we check what applies at your location.

items.title: Tax deductions
items.text: On existing buildings, photovoltaic investments are treated as maintenance costs and are deductible in practically all cantons today; the practice of your canton remains decisive (in the canton of Solothurn, for example, buildings under five years old are excluded). With the system change to the imputed rental value, the energy-saving deduction for direct federal tax will cease as of 1 January 2029.

paths.title: Two routes to your own system – both easy to plan.
paths.lead: Whether from your own funds or in instalments: which route fits is up to your household.

items.title: Self-financing
items.lead: You invest once and benefit in full from the first day of operation.
points: Tax deduction in the year of payment, depending on cantonal practice
Every kilowatt-hour saved eases your bill from day one

items.title: Instalment financing via Swiss partners
items.lead: On request, we put you in touch with Swiss financing partners.
points: Monthly instalments instead of a one-off investment
Terms and credit checks are handled by the partner

paths.disclaimer: On request we refer you to Swiss financing partners, but we do not provide financial, investment or tax advice – terms are agreed solely by the partner.

economics.title: Calculated over the whole life cycle.
economics.lead: The best return does not come from the biggest system, but from the one whose electricity you use yourself – over 25 to 30 years of operation.
items: Self-consumption determines the return more than system size.
A heat pump and an electric car shift consumption onto your own roof.
The inverter is typically replaced after 10 to 15 years – we factor that in.
Modules are designed for 25 to 30 years of operation with defined degradation.
We calculate conservatively and quote ranges rather than guaranteed payback periods.
